doan.chu: Hi, I’m Gia Han, a senior at Hanoi-Amsterdam High School for the Gifted. While traveling through Vietnam’s Northwestern mountains for volunteer trips and to work with local tea producers, I often found myself navigating through a string of unfamiliar coordinates. Many places had no names on Google Maps, no photos, reviews, or contact information. It took me three wrong turns before I finally found the right tea workshop and its owner. If it was difficult for me, I wondered how much harder it would be for other travelers to discover these places.

Yet behind those coordinates were breathtaking landscapes, living cultures, skilled artisans, and small communities with stories worth hearing. Rooted Routes Vietnam was created to become a bridge, connecting overlooked destinations and local businesses with people eager to discover them. By putting these places on the map, we hope to make exploring Vietnam more accessible, responsible, and rooted in respect for the communities that make each destination unique.
To make every corner of Vietnam visible, accessible, and valued—while ensuring that tourism becomes a bridge between travelers and local communities, rather than a burden on the places they visit.

doan.chu: Rooted Routes Vietnam connects travelers with the places, cultures, and people behind the map. By bringing together reliable travel information, cultural guidance, and local businesses on one interactive platform, we aim to make exploring Vietnam easier, more respectful, and more beneficial to the communities that call these destinations home.

Our content is built from a combination of first-hand documentation and publicly available sources. Whenever possible, we use original photographs and observations collected directly during visits to each destination. These are supplemented by information from reliable online sources to provide travelers with accurate and comprehensive guidance.
We believe that understanding a place should go beyond simply finding it on a map - it should also mean learning about the people, culture, and stories that make it uniquee.
